scope: Import semantics, bounded file-alias reuse, and targeted YAML dependency repair; local macOS aarch64. Mutation execution covers the three changed production modules plus configuration/workspace YAML ingress.
changes: Decode Unicode escapes in bare require identifiers with no decoded-name allocation.

Iteratively unwrap transparent TypeScript assertions, non-null and instantiation expressions around callees and literal arguments; retain computed/member exclusions and avoid interpreting type-only strings as values.
Memoize canonical matched file aliases and missing matches per extraction, with workspace precedence, payload admission, a concurrent-insertion recheck and typed limit propagation.
Refresh only serde-saphyr 2.1.0 to 2.1.1 in both locked graphs after registry yank; require the patch minimum, refresh build trust and verify blank/null configuration behavior.
Extend the actual native semantic fuzz oracle to 7 JS, 20 TS and 18 TSX literal forms, retaining the 256-scalar value bound and a 32-KiB program cap with a worst-expansion seed.
